cards.card_text: The letter is for all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, and the overseers and deacons get a shout-out too, so the WHOLE group chat is on this one.
cards.verse_text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
cards.snippet: …the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord…

cards.card_text: Now Paul turns to deacons, who must be dignified and not given to much wine or greedy for money.
cards.verse_text: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.
